details:
With vrchat’s recent update to the UI’s, it added an option to toggle your HUD, which i believe is actually a really good thing! It clears up space and isn't a small blur in the corner 24/7
However, my main issue with this is that it doesn't just hide the mic icon. It hides every single icon that can show up in game (I.E: invites, replies, add friends, etc) and as of now when you log out then back in it turns back on automatically
So on top of having it be a option that isnt turned back on automatically, i also propose a small fix to this issue of everything being hidden: custom HUD options. This would be a feature where you can toggle the showing of certain icons! Wanna hide the mic icon but have regular notifications go through? you could do that! want certain notifications to go through instead of others (i.e: only friends in favorites/select friends can have the invites icon show)? Thats an option too! 
As well with this, possible icon customizations for who you receive the notifications from: a small picture of the users icon showing up on the envelope front so you can tell exactly who sent it without having to open it and check in the quick menu, or the icon of the person that sent you a friend request. 
i believe this would be a really cool feature to add into the game to make it easier to customize and play with
title: Custom HUD options (and a small fix)
